title: pulicaria scabra
intro: Pulicaria scabra, commonly known as Khartoum bugloss, is a perennial plant species within the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pulicaria scabra include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating skin infections, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Pulicaria scabra include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
